channel.title: Market Pressure Map · Indian markets
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Indian market sectors and the rupee, bonds, inflation and foreign flows.

item.title: Markets hold the Diwali Muhurat session today after the Sensex's 7.5% weekly gain to 81,028
item.description:
The one-hour session runs in the afternoon; markets shut on Tuesday, 10 November. Sensex added 5,631.69 points in 2–6 November. Muhurat sessions have closed higher for seven years. Rally ongoing.

Why it matters: A holiday-shortened week after a huge rally leaves Indian stocks sensitive to oil and Hormuz headlines; the session is mostly symbolic.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: Foreign investors put ₹38,971 crore into Indian equities this week, depository data show
item.description:
Five straight days of buying reversed October's ₹52,100 crore exit, helped by the US election, the oil crash and a rotation from US AI stocks. Inflows are still small against two years of selling. Reversal.

Why it matters: Large foreign inflows support large caps and the rupee; their persistence depends on oil staying near $100 or lower.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +3, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: Houthis claim six missile and drone attacks on Saudi oil sites and Riyadh airport
item.description:
Targets reportedly included oil tanks, a distillation tower and a pumping station; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed damage. Saudi strikes killed dozens in Yemen. Escalating.

Why it matters: Attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure threaten a key Indian crude supplier and could revive the oil risk premium after last week's slide.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: days

item.title: US forces fire on and disable a ship trying to breach the Iran blockade; Iran blacklists more ships
item.description:
Iranian media say 11 tankers caught fire over nine days; another tanker hit a mine. Qatar says both sides remain committed to talks. Ongoing standoff.

Why it matters: Continued blockade clashes keep shipping risk high in the Gulf, sustaining freight and insurance costs for India-bound cargo.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: Hormuz could reopen under a Qatari plan tied to Iranian nuclear inspections
item.description:
The framework would trade an end to attacks for lifting the US port blockade. Iran called the US reply 'unconvincing'. Diplomacy ongoing.

Why it matters: A reopening would ease oil, LNG and freight costs for India; uncertainty keeps confidence low.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks

item.title: Hormuz disruption risks a global LNG crunch this winter, threatening India's power and gas costs
item.description:
Analysts warn constrained Gulf flows could tighten LNG supply as winter demand rises. Follows a 6% jump in global LNG prices last week. Ongoing risk.

Why it matters: Tighter LNG would raise costs for gas-based power, fertiliser and city gas, adding to subsidies and electricity tariffs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: Shippers seek Houthi approval for Red Sea transits under a new request mechanism
item.description:
Some firms now email the group for passage through Bab al-Mandab; analysts expect freight rates to fall 30% in 2027 as capacity returns. Easing.

Why it matters: Shorter Red Sea routing would cut freight costs and transit times for Indian exporters to Europe.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: India opens 2027 concessional-duty quotas for 24,500 British cars under the UK trade deal
item.description:
Quotas also cover 2,750 goods vehicles; applications close 21 November. Implements the pact in force since 15 July. New step.

Why it matters: Cheaper imported premium cars add competition for local luxury carmakers; limited quotas keep the impact small.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
